body.name: radius-adaptive mixing-overlap balanced history depth
body.construction:
Let \(q_C:=(C-1)/C\) and \(D_0:=2\log(1/\alpha)+\log L\).  Define
\[
 \kappa_T(C):=
 \begin{cases}
 0,&Tq_C^2\le1,\\
 \displaystyle\min\!\left\{\left\lfloor T/2\right\rfloor,
 \left\lfloor\frac{\log(Tq_C^2)}{D_0}\right\rfloor\right\},&Tq_C^2>1,
 \end{cases}
 \qquad k_T:=\kappa_T(C).
\]
